label: Applies to every medium
_note: Cross-cutting policy. Media files extend this. Nothing here duplicates the master.

match_policy._note: Defines what exact_only means. Resolved per dimension, not globally.

constraints.message: When budget_includes_gst is true the ex-GST ceiling is budget / 1.18. Never plan against the gross figure.
GST is 18 percent on every priced media option in the master. Flag any line that differs.
Printing and mounting is absent from the master for most options. It must be priced by the desk and shown as a separate line. Never let a plan consume 100 percent of budget before printing is known.
constraints.source: pricing_option_values is empty for the audited transit options
constraints.fix: Hold a printing reserve, size the flexible leg after the reserve.

constraints.message: specific_buying_rate is NULL. Margin cannot be verified on this line.
The quoted rate is at or below the buying rate. This line loses money.
constraints.fix: Quote offer_rate, not discounted_rate, or get the buying rate corrected.

constraints.message: Product names repeat with different SKUs. Deduplicate by name before offering, or the same inventory is offered twice.
constraints.source: 181 duplicate product rows across 81 names, Vande Bharat appears 79 times

constraints.message: On-request options carry no firm rate and cannot be auto-planned.
Inactive products must never reach a client sheet.

scenarios.message: Plan uses under 85 percent of budget. Show the desk the maximum quantity the budget supports.
Plan exceeds budget. Report infeasible with the nearest feasible plan, never silently overspend.
First-time advertiser. Attach the guidance notes and set expectations on printing and lead time.
Multi-media plan. One workbook, one sheet per medium, plus a Summary sheet that totals them.

do: State the size in sqft for every unit.
Show the GST basis explicitly and say whether the total is inclusive.
Quote printing and mounting as a separate line, or say plainly that it is not yet quoted.
Name the exact product and panel specification being sold.
dont: Never restate or round a total in narrative text. Reference the sheet.
Never fill a field the master does not carry. Leave it blank for the desk.
Never substitute a different city, medium or panel spec without flagging it.
first_time_advertiser: Outdoor works on repeat exposure. Under one month rarely registers.
Printing and mounting is a real, separate cost. Budget for it from the start.
Artwork must be supplied per medium at the correct aspect ratio. One design does not scale across media.
Photographs are the deliverable proof, supplied after execution.
guidance.tone: Plain, factual, commercial. No marketing superlatives. Indian number formatting.
